objective: Fix Android NativeAd lifecycle teardown during navigation between ad-safe routes, while preserving consent and existing offscreen native impression safety.
productionBaselineEvidence: Production main remains 7ebbbd504df2f84355888cc64a8c5317319d6d65; this isolated fix is DEV only and does not publish an OTA.
chosenApproach: Remove an unnecessary pathname dependency from the native SDK request/cleanup effect. The separately computed keepNativeLifecycle already considers route safety and controls actual disposal. Keep all SDK callbacks and timeouts unchanged.
selectionRationale: Preserve legitimately filled native creatives across harmless route changes without new ad demand or early impressions.
alternativeApproaches: Destroy every creative on route transitions (rejected: risks filling delay/cooldown).
preserveBehaviors: NativeAdView only mounts after eligible viewport.
No new ad unit IDs, no offscreen impression, no bypass of SDK consent, cooldown, typing lock or app lifecycle.
Disable native creative and cleanup when safety and retention gates truly disallow it.
No production, staging, web or database mutation.
acceptanceChecks: Native SDK effect does not restart on pathname changes alone; route lock still tears down ad.
No premature offscreen ad view or impression.
Engineering Accountability and focused tests pass against exact source SHA.
Staging and production release remain explicitly gated.
